ImageDescription.value: A modern exterior photograph of Rockhill House Estate, a 17th-century historic country house located in Letterkenny, County Donegal, Ireland. The image shows the main facade, which features the 1824 Georgian extensions designed by architect John Hargrave, following the property's comprehensive restoration between 2014 and 2017.
